queries.text: "a irritação da dúvida, como diz Peirce" refers to Charles S. Peirce’s "irritation of doubt" ("The Fixation of Belief", 1877), the established English phrase.

The original reads "Slayne, o herói celta de Path Mills"; corrected to Sláine, the Celtic hero of Pat Mills’s comic series (2000 AD). The quoted lines are translated from the author’s Portuguese; the original English wording of the comic was not checked.
